title: hamster-animator
description: Turns radiative transfer simulations of protoplanetary disks into animations: camera flights, polarimetry, runs locally or on SLURM.
note: Code available on request (HAMSTER is not yet public)
caption: A simulated protoplanetary disk at λ = 1.6 µm, seen at 55° inclination, intensity scaled by r². The camera circles the disk.

title: IGSN Helper
description: Drafts IGSN sample metadata from free-text lab submissions with a local LLM, checking every value against the source.
caption: From a free-text lab submission to draft IGSN records: a local LLM extracts the facts, every value is checked against the source, and a curator reviews the result.
